name: What types of benefits can I receive through workers' compensation?

mainEntity.name: What types of benefits can I receive through workers' compensation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Workers' compensation benefits typically include medical care for your work-related injury or illness, temporary disability benefits to replace lost wages while you are recovering, and permanent disability benefits if your injury results in a lasting impairment. In some cases, vocational rehabilitation services may be provided to help you return to work. In the unfortunate event of a work-related death, death benefits are provided to dependents. Your attorney can ensure you receive all eligible benefits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include medical care, temporary and permanent disability payments for lost wages and impairment, vocational rehabilitation, and death benefits.
